notes.title: Anniversary update!
notes.content:
Hey all, 

Anniversary update is live! We've added daily runs, achievements, and even more dad customizations! We've also tweaked the difficulty a bit to make the game a little easier. 

This is probably going to be the last update for this game. May do some tweaks but nothing major like this update is. We're glad to have come this far and appreciate everyone who has been with us for the ride. 

Thanks for seeing us this far! See you all in game 2!

- Exploding Knees team
